response.justification: The candidate is a strong full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with broad experience across languages and platforms, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator architecture, GPU/SIMD-MIMD systems, or deep-learning workload performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive and long software engineering career (15+ years) meeting seniority/experience bar
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU/accelerator experience
No indication of eligibility for export-control/citizenship security screening requirements

key_factors.factor: No deep-learning or GPU workload optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
